Music / Human at the center. AI in the room.

Human voices · AI partnership

Human at the center. AI in the room.

The music is personal and human-made, with AI used openly as a serious creative and production partner.

01

Most of the singing is human.

Most of the vocals across this catalog are mine or performances by other real people. Friends, family, and collaborators bring their own voices and presence into the work.

I began by experimenting more heavily with AI voices. I still use them occasionally when they fit a song, but they are one color in the palette—not the whole picture.

02

I play, record, and arrange.

Depending on where and how I record, I also play some of the instruments. Each release can combine live performance, programmed parts, arrangement, editing, and collaboration in a different way.

The point is not to pretend every sound came from the same process. It is to shape the strongest honest version of the song.

03

AI is a real creative partner.

I use AI heavily for ideation, iteration, cleanup, and polish. It helps me explore possibilities, repair rough edges, and carry a human performance or idea to a publishable finish.

That sits alongside the editing, correction, layering, and processing tools recorded music has used for years. I am transparent about it because the partnership matters to how this work is made.

04

The soul is not synthetic.

There is a lot of me in this music: my history, feelings, friends, family, and memories of people who are no longer here.

The catalog carries blood, sweat, tears, play, grief, and love. AI helps me make those ideas clearer and more polished; it does not replace the lives behind them.
